title: O.A./3240/2015 — DHARMENDER PAL v. M/O DEFENCE
text:

New Delhi, this the 1st day of September, 2015.
HON’BLE MR. V. AJAY KUMAR, MEMBER (J)

OA 3240/2015
2
ORDER (ORAL)
Heard Shri V.P.S. Tyagi for the applicant and Shri
Acharya Santosh Prasad Chaurasiya for the respondents.
2. The present O.A. is filed by the applicant seeking a
direction to the respondents to consider his case for
appointment on compassionate grounds. It is also submitted
that the applicant made number of representations, though
the respondents have not considered his case, but have
appointed so many others, who were juniors to the applicant
in the seniority list. However, the applicant has not mentioned
any names or details of such persons, who were allegedly
considered by the respondents in violation of the seniority list.
3. In the circumstances, the O.A. and the M.A. are disposed of
at the admission stage, without going into the merits of the
case, by permitting the applicant to make an appropriate
representation to the respondents by mentioning the names
and details of those persons whose cases were said to be
considered by the respondents overlooking the case of the
applicant, within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy
of this order, and on receipt of such a representation from the
applicant, the respondents shall consider the same and pass

OA 3240/2015
3
appropriate reasoned and speaking orders, in accordance with
law, within eight weeks therefrom. No order as to costs.
(V. AJAY KUMAR)
Member (J)
/Jyoti/
